in_sanskrit.name: Nipan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है To Shine, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nipan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nipan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipana' which means 'to shine' or 'to radiate'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to bring light and knowledge into the world. It is a powerful name that represents wisdom and enlightenment.
